verdict.pick: Dearfoams Fireside Sydney Genuine Shearling Scuff Slipper
verdict.line: Picture a cozy evening at home: the Fireside Sydney keeps feet warm with its genuine shearling lining and scuff‑resistant sole. It is the only model listed in both Nordstrom and DSW, showing broad retailer confidence. The catch: it has no waterproof feature.
